raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misconstrued the physics of motion initiation by claiming forces are balanced at the onset of sliding and selecting option A. In reality, motion begins when forces become unbalanced (static friction can no longer match the applied force, dropping to kinetic friction), causing acceleration; thus the correct reasoning is option B. The Planner prematurely marked the task complete and did not validate this against fundamental Newtonian principles.
